name: mods
description: mods — Ramon's Claude Code mods: hooks modules that change the interface

plugins.name: host
plugins.description: The box this session runs on: one band above the prompt with cpu, load, memory, swap traffic, disk, worktree trees, claude processes, ssh peers, tailscale; a pane behind it with the breakdown and the hungriest processes. /host toggles the band, /host pane the pane.

plugins.name: limits
plugins.description: Logs the subscription's rate-limit windows — five_hour and seven_day percent used, and when each resets — to ~/.lore/limits.jsonl (LORE_HOME when set), one line per whole-point move, from every session that has it. No UI, no token: the figures the status line already shows, kept, so lore can read the exchange rate between tokens and the sub.
